decisions: Do not expose a raw bit0x400 enemy pause: native pooled-object reuse and motion postpasses also own this bit.

Descriptor slot+32 is a promising narrower regular-AI update boundary in three verified base families. An actual feature still requires exact family/target/lifetime gates, dispatch scope and original-call/unload proof.
Do not use native stop IDs as private ownership without proving noncollision and four-slot capacity; Round6 found unchecked null writes in full-slot paths.
next: Trace concrete subclass descriptor slot+32 overrides and direct3B4460/VM entries before choosing an AI control.
Do not mistake shared body/tailcall equality for complete AI coverage.
